tasks.short: Document hardware and software installation procedures

steps.what: Collect hardware and software installation notes
Document procedures for installation and use

loop.input: source notes and the procedure template
loop.output: procedure draft with each step tied to a hardware id
loop.check: Every hardware id and software id equals the source notes
loop.stop: Leave a section blank and stop it if the id is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use steps differ by hardware and a fixed paragraph would be wrong

tasks.design: Install notes name hardware id, software id, site and the steps last used. A template in {DOCS} drafts the procedure for installation and use from those fields. Metadata columns for hardware id, software id and version may be filled from the notes, and the specialist checks them because a fill can be wrong. The procedure body is not trusted from that fill. The specialist signs one version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Install steps lived in personal notes, so a new procedure copied a step for hardware that had already changed.
tasks.enabler_now: A hardware id and a software id can sit on the note and on the procedure file, so each step can be tied to an id.
tasks.still_hard: The use steps that depend on how people actually fail still need the specialist's edit.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides which steps are safe to publish and which old step must not be copied.

ambition.what: Revise the procedure when the install steps change, not only when someone asks

tasks.altitude: Less time retyping the same install steps. The specialist can refuse a procedure whose hardware id or version does not match the notes.

reach.task: Hand the signed procedure to the person doing the next install
reach.learn: Which hardware has a signed procedure and which use steps are still blank

evidence.claim: Installation procedures in a mid-size firm are documents rewritten from the last job. The hard part is the use steps, not the headings.
Digest [S3] says a document product can fill metadata from a prompt, and the vendor warns the fill can be wrong. Use that only for hardware id, software id and version, not for the procedure body.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task ends when a signed procedure version is filed. Performing the install is a later task.

Input contract: hardware id, software id, site, version, step text from the last install. Producer is the specialist from the last install notes. If the notes have no hardware id, that section stays blank and is typed by hand.
Use the document store's own templates, metadata and approval before custom code. Most of this task is the document. The meeting prior is not the main means.
unknowns: Who may sign a procedure when the specialist is absent.
Whether use steps differ by site for the same hardware id.
research_questions: How often does a signed procedure differ from the last install?
Which hardware types have no procedure at all?

already_counted.description: Specialist edits use steps the template got wrong
Metadata check stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Update the procedure template when a new hardware type appears

approvals.approved_version: installation procedure version signed in this review
the same signed installation procedure version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes notes stay unstructured, so the specialist still writes most steps. The high case assumes the template drafts cleanly but every use-step edit and every sign-off stays manual. Doing the install is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assign the maintenance for this equipment

tasks.design: Due maintenance appears on a {BI} list with equipment id, site and due date. The list does not score staff. The specialist still supervises the work in person or on a call, and the vendor engineer may do the maintenance. The specialist signs that the equipment was maintained. The list does not perform the maintenance, and a live job is never unattended.
tasks.previous_blocker: Due dates lived in mail and memory, so supervision started from whoever shouted last.
tasks.enabler_now: Equipment id, site and due date can sit on one list taken from the maintenance record.
tasks.still_hard: Supervising the person on the equipment, and judging that the work is actually done, stays a presence.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides the work is finished and stops a job that looks unsafe.
tasks.altitude: Finding the next due item takes less mail. The specialist still supervises, and can refuse to sign equipment they did not see maintained.

reach.task: Read which equipment was signed off this period
reach.learn: Which equipment is overdue and which signature is current

evidence.claim: Supervising telecommunications maintenance is people work on site or on a call. A due list can order the day. It does not watch how a person works.
Digest [S28] reports a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so unattended maintenance on live equipment is out of scope.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task is supervision, not the writing of the maintenance procedure.
Input contract: equipment id, site, due date, vendor name if any. Producer is the maintenance record. A row with no equipment id is not assigned.

Use the existing maintenance list or calendar before custom code. The meeting prior is accepted. The list is equipment due dates, not staff monitoring, so works-council consent for watching staff is not in this design.
unknowns: Which equipment the vendor maintains without the specialist present.
Who may sign when the specialist is absent.
research_questions: What share of due equipment has no visit in the period?
How often does the specialist refuse to sign a vendor's maintenance note?

already_counted.description: Assigning the work stays with the specialist
Supervision on site or on the call stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Keep the due-list fields aligned when a new equipment type is added

approvals.approved_version: maintenance record signed for this equipment id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the due list stays incomplete, so supervision is unchanged. The high case assumes the list is clean but every site visit and every signature stays manual. The maintenance labour itself is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct users on voice, video and data systems

loop.input: system name, channel and the note template
loop.output: use note that names the system and three actions
loop.check: The system name and the channel match the outline
loop.stop: One draft, then stop if the system name is missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Voice, video and data actions are not the same paragraph

steps.what: Instruct on voice, video and communications systems
Try the system and ask questions

tasks.design: A short use note in {DOCS} names the voice, video or data communications system, the audience and the actions to show. The specialist still instructs the system user in person or on a call. Questions and practice stay a conversation. Staff who miss the session can read the signed note. The note does not replace the instruction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Use notes were slides in a mailbox, so someone who missed the session had no current version to read.
tasks.enabler_now: The system name and the audience can sit on one note, and a session can point at that version.
tasks.still_hard: People learn this by trying it with a person. A note does not see where they get stuck.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist sees who is lost and changes the explanation on the spot.

ambition.what: Staff who cannot attend the session still get the signed use note

tasks.altitude: Preparing the same explanation takes less time. The instruction stays a conversation. The specialist decides when the note is fit to hand to someone who was absent.

reach.task: Try the system from the signed use note
reach.learn: Which actions the note covers and which questions still need the specialist

evidence.claim: Instructing people in voice, video and data systems is a conversation. A short note can be reused. It does not replace the session.
In a mid-size firm the same three actions are shown repeatedly. The audience and the system name change. The stumbling does not.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task ends when the session is done and the note version is filed. It is not a support ticket.
Input contract: system name, channel (voice, video or data), audience, three actions, session date. Producer is the specialist. A note with no system name is not filed.
Use the document template before custom code. The meeting prior is accepted: instruction stays in person or on a call.
unknowns: Which audiences must attend rather than read the note.
Whether the note may be shared outside the team.
research_questions: What share of invited users miss the session?
Which questions repeat often enough to add to the note?

already_counted.description: Specialist edits the use note before signing
The instruction session stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Revise the use note when the system actions change

approvals.approved_version: use note version signed for this session
the same signed use note version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes every session is still built from scratch and nobody reads the note. The high case assumes the note is reused but every instruction and every question stays a conversation. Attendance time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Install, remove or relocate user connectivity equipment

steps.what: Request the move with personnel and facilities
Check connectivity equipment at both locations
Coordinate facilities management staff on the move
Install, remove or relocate connectivity equipment
Confirm the device works at the new location

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} move request names the system user, the device, the from-location, the to-location and the date. The specialist checks both locations and coordinates facilities staff through the service owner. The install, remove or relocate happens in person and is never unattended. The user confirms the device. Only then is the location record filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Moves arrived as mail with a person's name and no device id, so two visits could target different desks.
tasks.enabler_now: A request can carry a device id, a from-location and a to-location on one row.
tasks.still_hard: The cable, the desk and the person still have to be in the same place. A form does not move equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides the move is safe to do that day and stops it when the location is wrong.
tasks.altitude: Scheduling takes less mail. The specialist still goes to the desk, and can refuse to file a move they did not complete.

reach.task: Confirm the device works at the new location
reach.learn: Which device was meant to move, and whether the record is filed

evidence.claim: Moving user connectivity equipment is in-person work with facilities staff and the user. The request and the location record are the parts that can be structured.
Digest [S28] reports a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so an unattended change that installs, removes or relocates live connectivity equipment is out of scope.

assumptions: Focal role is the telecommunications specialist. The task ends when the move is confirmed and the location record is filed, or the move is stopped.
Input contract: device id, system user, from-location, to-location, date, facilities contact. Producer is the service owner. A request with no device id or no to-location is not scheduled.

Use the workflow form and the calendar before custom code. The in-person prior is accepted. Facilities staff are reached through the service owner. This design does not track how long a person was away from their desk.
unknowns: Which buildings require a facilities escort.
Whether the specialist or a vendor engineer does the cable work.
research_questions: What share of move requests has no device id?
How often is a move stopped because the to-location is wrong?

already_counted.description: Coordination with facilities stays with the specialist
The physical move stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Keep the move form aligned when a new device type appears
Service owners resubmit requests that lack a device id

approvals.approved_version: move done for this device id and date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes requests stay as mail, so the visit is unchanged. The high case assumes the request is clean but every coordination and every physical move stays manual. No unattended move is treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Procedures and move records get lighter. Supervision, instruction and the physical move of connectivity equipment stay with the specialist.
reach: The system user receives the use note and the completed move record.
The service owner sees which equipment was signed off as maintained.
skills_to_grow: Write an install procedure as steps a template can reuse.
Supervise from an equipment list rather than a mailbox thread.
Separate a use note from the live instruction.
role.ambitious_version: Each hardware type has a signed install procedure, and a move closes with a location record the same day.
